RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the December 7, 2006/Agrahayana 16, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North-Eastern Region; External
Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Information and
Broadcasting; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances
and Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport
and Highways; Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Urban Development;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Amount provided to Nepal
†*221. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the amount provided by
Government for the development of Nepal
during the last five years;
(b) whether it has been brought to
Government’s notice that the expenditure
from the amount provided by India is quite
low in the districts where citizens of Indian
origin reside; and
(c) whether Government have done any
review in this regard?
Shortage of housing units
†*222. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of  HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made an
estimation about the shortage of housing
units in the country;
(b) if so, the estimated shortage of
housing units by the end of March, 2006;
(c) whether Government have fixed any
target regarding the construction of housing
units upto 2008-09; and
(d) if so, the number of housing units to
be constructed under the said target and
the total amount incurred thereon?
Setting up of atomic energy plant at
Srikakulum
*223. SHRI SUDARSHAN
AKARAPU: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up an Atomic Energy Plant in
Srikakulum district of Andhra Pradesh;

70
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the State Government of
Andhra Pradesh have accepted the
proposal;
(d) whether it is a fact that the local
population in this area are opposing the
setting up of this Atomic Energy Plant;
and
(e) if so,the measures Government
propose to take to allay the fear of local
public?
Allocation to Rajasthan under
AUWSP
*224. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the overall urban water supply
status/scenario in India, particularly in
Rajasthan;
(b) the amount allocated by the Central
Government to Rajasthan under
Accelerated Urban Water Supply
Programme (AUWSP)  during the last three
years and whether it has been allocated
according to laid down yardstick;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
results achieved;
(d) whether there are any proposals
from the State Government that are still
pending for consideration; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the likely
schedule of disposal?
Installation of hoardings on roads
*225. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of  URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that hoardings
are installed on important roads in Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that these
hoardings would lead to losing of
concentration of the drivers; and
(d) if so, the steps Government are
taking to remove these hoardings?
Performance of States under
MPLADS
*226. SHRI URKHAO GWRA
BRAHMA: Will the Minister of
STATISTICS AND PROGRAMME
IMPLEMENTATION be pleased to state:
(a) the list of States giving good
performance and poor performance in the
implementation of MPLADS fund since
its inception;
(b) the reasons for poor performance
and measures to improve the same;
(c) the steps to make the administration
more active for speedy disposal at the
district level; and
(d) the decision if any to enhance the
total yearly allocation of Rupees two crore
fund under MPLADS?
NHs in North East
*227. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of the roads proposed by
different States of the North-Eastern
Region for inclusion as National Highways;
(b) the names of the roads accepted by
the DoNER, those rejected and those kept
under consideration; and
(c) the reasons where the proposals
have been rejected?

71
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Potential of Orissa coast
*228. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Orissa coast has good potential in the port
sector, yet it remains to be tapped; and
(b) if so, the action plan of Government
to help the State to exploit this potential to
improve the economy of this backward
State?

Section of NH-8A

SHRI VIJAYKUMAR
RUPANI:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) wheth

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
370
Expansion of atomic energy in the
country
†1639. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that targets for
expansion of atomic energy have been set
by Government;
(b) if so, the details of these targets and
by when these are being decided to be
achieved;
(c) whether the dependence of the
country on the import of fuel would increase
to achieve the target; and
(d) if so, percentage of supply of fuel
to be met with imports?
Poduction of atomic power
1640. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that after the
World War II and after obtaining
independence in 1947 A.D., India is at the
mercy of the powerful countries in the
matter of atomic power/energy;
(b) if not, the details of the atomic
power/energy produced by India herself
and expected;
(c) how India has been successful to
get atomic power/energy from USA,
France, Israel, Germany, Japan during the
last 30 years to become self-dependent;
and
(d) if not, how this problem is expected
to be solved?

371
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Protest against not filling sands
†1641. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any agitation has been
staged recently in protest against not filling
sands in sufficient quantity below the
surface after mining of coal from
underground mines in Talcher city which is
under the control of M.C.L. situated in
Orissa;
(b) whether any memorandum has been
submitted to the 'National Human Rights
Commission' in this regard; and
(c) whether owing to these very
agitations, the higher authorities of M.C.L.
have given assurance of starting sand filling
by the 15th December?
Separation of cutting and loading by
SECL
†1642. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) the justification of separating, cutting
and loading in the tender inviting notice of
surface minor machine by SECL
Undertaking in the year 2003-04;
(b) whether it is a fact that award of
tender to the same company could have
been avoided had the cutting and loading in
the tender been not separated;
(c) whether it was a deliberate act of
SECL administration that if cutting and
loading were not separated then the
companies other than the said company
would also have participated in the tender;
and
(d) the additional expenditure cost to
SECL due to such bifurcation of cutting
and loading?
Revival of Dankuni Coal Complex,
CIL
1643. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry is considering
revival of Dankuni Coal Complex, a unit of
Coal India Limited;
(b) if so, the action taken so far by
Government for the same;
(c) whether any capital investment is
being considered for the revival; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Penalties for using forest land in
Chhattisgarh
1644. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a subsidiary
of Coal India Ltd. has been asked by the
Apex Court to pay penalties for continuing
its operations in Chhattisgarh and using
forest land there;
(b) if so, the details of the penalties
levied on the subsidiary company;
(c) whether any responsibility has been
fixed; if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether the total penalty has been
paid?
Policy on private sector ownership of
coal mines
1645. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the policy of Government on private
sector ownership of coal mines; and

372
(b) whether there is any proposal to
review the current policy?
MoU for setting up power project at
Pipavav, Gujarat
1646. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
of Gujarat and NTPC have signed an MoU
for setting up of 1000 MW Power Project
at Pipavav in joint venture;
(b) if so, the present status of the
project;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
project is held up due to non-allotment of
Coal Mining Block to NTPC by the
Ministry of Coal;
(d) if so, the reasons for the delay in
allotment of the Coal Mining Block to
NTPC; and
